title: Apply to register a plant design
summary: This page provides information on how to apply to register a plant design with SafeWork NSW or a corresponding WHS regulator.
intro:
The design of certain items of plant must be registered with SafeWork NSW or a corresponding work health and safety (WHS) regulator.

who_can_apply: Boilers and pressure vessels categorized as hazard level A, B, C or D according to criteria in Section 2.1 of AS 4343, with some exceptions.
Gas cylinders covered by section 1.1 of AS 2030.
Tower cranes, including self-erecting tower cranes.

Gantry cranes with a safe working load (SWL) greater than 5 tonnes, or bridge cranes with a SWL greater than 10 tonnes, and any gantry crane or bridge crane which is designed to handle molten metal or Schedule 11 hazardous chemicals.
Mobile cranes with a rated capacity of greater than 10 tonnes.
Vehicle hoists, and hoists with a platform movement exceeding 2.4 metres, designed to lift people.
Work boxes designed to be suspended from cranes.
Amusement devices covered by section 2.1 of AS 3533, with some exceptions.
what_you_need: A completed Plant designer and design verifier statement – PDF, which must include: a valid email address, your business details (if applicable), your contact details, design registration specifications.
Verified representational drawing(s) for the plant design, in English.

how_to_steps.text: Ensure you have the required supporting documentation.

faqs.q: Do I need to re-register a design if it only needs a minor correction, like a typo?
faqs.a: No, designs that only need a correction such as a typo do not have to be re-registered. You should email licensing@safework.nsw.gov.au with details of the corrections required.

faqs.q: Who needs to register the plant design?
faqs.a: The designer of the plant or the person with management or control of the plant must register the design.

faqs.q: What types of plant designs require registration?
faqs.a: Designs that require registration include boilers and pressure vessels (hazard levels A, B, C or D), gas cylinders, lifts, escalators, moving walkways, tower cranes, gantry cranes, mobile cranes, hoists, mast climbing work platforms, building maintenance units, work boxes, concrete placing booms, prefabricated scaffolding, passenger ropeways, boom-type elevating work platforms, amusement devices, and others listed in the Work Health and Safety Regulation 2025.
